requirement: Translator is easy for NMHS operators to use.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test ratings for "easy to use" average >= 4 of 5; no Critical usability blockers in Error Reports.

requirement: Convert workflow is clear and intuitive for operational MET staff.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test ratings for "workflow clear and intuitive" average >= 4 of 5.

requirement: TAC-to-IWXXM translation completes in time that operators rate as sufficiently fast.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test ratings for "translation sufficiently fast" average >= 4 of 5; no Major timeout patterns in Test Log.

requirement: Error and lint messages are understandable without developer support.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test ratings for "error messages understandable" average >= 4 of 5; Error Reports cite readable problem text.
notes: Questionnaire Likert statement; Testing Guide §5 Error handling

requirement: Generated IWXXM is readily validated against applicable schema and rules.
acceptance_criteria: Test Log IWXXM Validation = PASS for successful converts; operator can run validation without a separate offline tool for the beta path.

requirement: Operators can trust meteorological accuracy of generated IWXXM.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test confidence rating average >= 4 of 5; Comparison Checklist Correct? = yes for sampled elements; Critical severity = 0 on accuracy.

requirement: Tool is useful for further NMHS IWXXM implementation work.
acceptance_criteria: End-of-test "useful for further IWXXM implementation" average >= 4 of 5; focal points recommend continued operational testing.

requirement: Convert METAR, SPECI, TAF, and SIGMET from TAC to IWXXM.
acceptance_criteria: Each product has at least one PASS translation in the Service Test Log during the two-week window.

requirement: Generated IWXXM correctly represents meteorological information in the source TAC.
acceptance_criteria: For sampled messages, Comparison Checklist elements match TAC meaning and values (not textual appearance).

requirement: Resulting IWXXM conforms to applicable IWXXM schema and validation requirements.
acceptance_criteria: IWXXM Validation column PASS on successful converts; failures classified and filed in Error Reports.

requirement: Prototype is practical for operational meteorological personnel.
acceptance_criteria: Usability assessed in Week 2 parallel testing; Major usability Severity items resolved before wider regional use.

requirement: Identify or report translation problems, unsupported constructs, and invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid or unsupported TAC yields a clear failure or issue classification (Critical/Major/Minor) rather than silent wrong IWXXM.
notes: Testing Guide §5 Error handling; §8 Error Classification

requirement: Accept representative CMO test sets and live operational TAC without changing operational TAC production.
acceptance_criteria: Week 1 uses CMO representative datasets; Week 2 uses Service operational TAC in parallel; no change to operational dissemination required for the test.

requirement: Record successful and unsuccessful translations with TAC, IWXXM, and validation evidence on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Every failed or questionable Test Log row links an Error Report and retains source TAC plus generated IWXXM where possible.

requirement: Classify issues as Critical, Major, or Minor per CMO definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Test Log Severity uses Critical (wrong/missing meteorological meaning), Major (blocks wider use), or Minor (non-meaning issues).

requirement: Capture structured Error Reports with country/service, tester, UTC time, product, Test ID, problem, expected vs actual, and attachments.
acceptance_criteria: Each Critical/Major/questionable Test Log row references a completed Error Report with those fields filled.

requirement: Log each test with Week, Product, TAC reference, Translation Result, IWXXM Validation, TAC vs IWXXM Accurate, Severity, comment, evidence, and Retest Result.
acceptance_criteria: Summary sheets can count PASS/FAIL from drop-down values; empty required cells rejected for submitted logs.
notes: Test Log sheet columns and Instructions

requirement: METAR/SPECI IWXXM preserves station identifier and observation date/time from TAC.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for Station identifier and Observation date/time on sampled METAR/SPECI.

acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for Wind Visibility and RVR when present in TAC.

acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for those elements when present in TAC.

requirement: METAR/SPECI IWXXM preserves COR/related status and other applicable elements when present.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for COR/related status and other applicable elements when present in TAC.

requirement: TAF IWXXM preserves aerodrome identifier, issue time, and validity period.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for those TAF header elements.

requirement: TAF IWXXM preserves wind, visibility, weather, and cloud in base and change groups.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for those forecast elements when present.

requirement: TAF IWXXM preserves TEMPO, BECMG, PROB, and AMD/COR change constructs when present.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for change-group and AMD/COR rows when present in TAC.

requirement: SIGMET IWXXM preserves FIR/area, phenomenon, location/geometry, and vertical extent.

requirement: SIGMET IWXXM preserves movement, intensity/change, validity period, observed/forecast status, and amendment/cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist Correct? = yes for those SIGMET status and change elements when present.
